content.title: Fox Drives Red Lions Through an Extra-Time Classic
paragraphs: Red Lions won 3-2 after extra time, and Fox set the early pace by finishing Lane’s pass in the 28th minute. Blue Sharks replied through Gray in the 62nd minute, Red Lions moved back ahead when Reid scored from Rook’s pass in the 95th minute, and Cruz levelled for Blue Sharks in the 105th minute from Wells’ assist.

The turning point came in the 113th minute, when Bell turned the ball into Blue Sharks’ net for an own goal, sending Red Lions back in front. Fox was central to the story all night as captain, with 1 goal, 6 shots, 5 tackles won, 4 interceptions, 140 touches, and a yellow card.

Red Lions had the better of the match for long spells, moving the ball more sharply and spending much more time in Blue Sharks’ half. The closing stages were wild, but Red Lions kept pushing forward and spent the last part of extra time camped on the front foot to see it through.
